reviews.text: These people really care about the sensitivity of the situation. Very calming, heartwarming, and the quality of service is phenomenal. Andrea & Phillip I owe a very deserved Thank You, for taking such good care of my Halo, and bringing him home where he belongs beautifully. Much love .

Andrea and Philip are phenomenal people, caring, compassionate, and very committed to what they do. Philip was very informative and thorough during the inquiry call to them, when Andrea came out, took her time, talked to me and the family, got to know us, walked us through her process(it was our first time using an in home service, but not our first dog loss) especially with a next day appointment availability which was great.  Hanging out with Thor at 15 years old and visibly on his end stages of life, consoling and loving on him before starting the procedure. When Philip dropped by in the next week to deliver his cremains, the rosewood urn the clay paw, the lock of his fur, everything looked great, and the presentation was excellent. The velvet and satin bags included with the urn. It was an excellent experience from beginning to end. Would go with again, and would 100% recommend. The certificate of cremation unfortunately wasn't with the letter, but that's the least important part in my opinion. I got the ashes, urn, paw, and lock of fur, I still want it, and Philip was prompt in coordinating getting me a copy of it mailed to my address out of town because I'm just here visiting where the family dog lived his whole life.

Once again, excellent experience all the way around. Thanks Philip and Andrea for everything!

So glad I found Andrea through a friend. They were able to get me in last minute as my dog was suffering and needed to be immediately put down. What a traumatic and life altering experience that Andrea and her team made into a beautiful one. She was so kind, patient, thoughtful, and helped me navigate such big emotions. I couldn’t recommend this experience enough. After care also just tremendously thoughtful and well handled, the little details made a big impact. Thank you for everything you did for me and my little boy. I’ll never forget how compassionate you were to us.

It's a day that no pet owner wants to go through, and unfortunately my family had to make the decision to let our baby girl Lucy go. Dr. Andrea Leach is simply the best, showing up with a calm and soothing energy and explaining what the process is like. She is a wonderful human being and she shows such compassion towards animals, even in their last moments. Her husband Philip showed up to our house to drop off Lucy's ashes and paw print, and was very sweet and compassionate as well. Many thanks for the love and care you showed our family in this hard time, we won't forget it. 🫶🏽

I had to make the very difficult decision yesterday to have my little Jessie girl  puts to sleep. I talked to Phillip to make arrangements. He was very helpful as I went back-and-forth deciding what to do. When Dr. Andrea came out, she greeted my little dog with compassion and love. She explained every step for me which process easier for me. These two are the best!

There are not enough words so say about Philip and Andrea.
Orion was and still is very close to my heart. It was a very hard decision to make, but unfortunately there was no getting better and he suffered a lot.
As soon as I spoke with Philip on the phone, the gentle reassuring voice told me I got to the right place.
When Andrea arrived the day of, she brought a compassionate, empathetic, angelic energy, that didn't make this less painful, but completely changed the way I carry the memory of that day. Full of love and meaning.
The procedure was smooth and gentle.
The card Andrea made for us, was so personal and thoughtful.
And a week later Philip delivered us Orion's ashes, fur and paw print, all look very respectful and dignified.
I don't wish this on anyone, but if they must, I really wish for them to be guided to Philip and Andrea.
And I wish them the best on their wonderful path. 🩵

I can’t recommend them highly enough. Saying goodbye to our beloved 4 legged fur baby was one of the hardest things we’ve ever been through, but they made it as peaceful and comforting as possible. They were so kind, caring, and patient, and treated our sweet boy with so much love and respect. He was able to pass peacefully, surrounded by those who loved him most and at home. We are forever grateful and thank you for everything.

After watching our sweet 16‑year‑old kitty slowly decline, we woke up Friday morning to find that Patty could no longer walk. In that moment, we knew it was time to find someone who could come to our home and help her transition peacefully. It was an incredibly hard day already—our daughter was having all four wisdom teeth removed that same morning—and we desperately needed someone who could come that very day. We couldn’t bear the thought of Patty suffering through the long Memorial Day weekend.

We searched everywhere for a veterinarian who offered in‑home care, but every place we called was either unavailable or far beyond what we could manage. Then my husband spoke with Phillip, Dr. Andrea’s husband. He was so kind, so understanding, and—miraculously—had an opening that day.

We returned home from the tooth extraction, and shortly after, Dr. Andrea arrived. From the moment she stepped into our home, her gentle, compassionate presence brought comfort. Her kindness was felt immediately, and we knew Patty was in the best hands.

Thank you for taking such care with our Patty and remembering every one of our names as well!!!! It means the world to us!

Although I didn’t end up using HouseCollar Vet Home Euthanasia. I wanted to review this business anyway. Philip was kind and quite helpful when I was in emotional distress and reached out.   I ended up not euthanizing my cat at the last second because he pulled through and I received some new test results that were encouraging to a misdiagnosis.  I’ve worked in hospice care for 21 years and whether it’s a human or a pet they are family.  I appreciated not only the kindness during the consultation when I reached out, but also when I needed to cancel the appointment. This is a very professional, kind and respectful business.  I would recommend them in a time of need.  🩷
Thank you Andrea and Phillip, they are incredibly attentive and very compassionate, made our baby’s transition easy and comfortable. Thank you for loving our Girl Sam with us 💕

It was probably the most difficult decision that we have ever had to make for our beloved Lady. However, when lady made the decision for herself and passed on without assistance. We were grateful for Andrea and Philip to make things easier on us. They cancelled our scheduled appointment and scheduled a pick for Lady’s remains. Philip let us grieve our loss and even said some kind words before taking off with our Lady bug. It was such an emotional day for us all. He treated Lady with the most respect, dignity, and care. We have a drop off appointment for lady’s ashes and I cannot believe that they are going to take time out of their day to drop them off. So unbelievably grateful to them. Thank you both for the care and support throughout this ordeal. God bless
So empathetic and they made the most difficult time as kind as possible.

Andrea and Philip made our sweet Luna's transition so peaceful and filled with comfort. Andrea arrived gently and talked us through everything while being so kind and comforting. We are so grateful we could say goodbye at home and gently without moving Luna to a stressful vet office environment. Andrea waited until we were ready and communicated clearly about every step. Philip was very kind, responsive, and helpful while helping me navigate the details of making the arrangements. I would recommend them.

For such a hard life experience House Collar Vet made it more comfortable. We made the tough decision to put our dog down, Phillip and Andrea were great humans to help us thru it. Strongly recommend to help you thru this process.
